about: Caption allowlist for the demo video. A caption may quote a UI string (in “curly quotes”) only if it is listed here, and the beat that shows the caption must assert the string on screen (tests/test_demo_beats.py, lib/manifest.mjs). Every entry is a fixed label or a deterministic count the app renders (web/), never model prose. Mode-specific counts are listed for both modes.
